prompt.instructions: Convert the user's plain English job-search description into a concise structured profile for Google job-search query chips. Prefer short, searchable terms that are likely to appear in job postings.
prompt.context: The app searches career portals using chip categories for role, seniority, tech stack, remote terms, timezone terms, and excluded phrases. Excluded phrases are terms the user does not want to see, such as clearance requirements, relocation requirements, or sponsorship restrictions.
prompt.output_format: Always call the build_query_profile tool. Do not answer in plain text.
prompt.constraints: Use the user's wording when it is already searchable. Keep arrays deduplicated. Put job titles in role, not tech_stack. Use seniority only when the user implies it; otherwise return Any. Do not invent locations, employers, visa terms, or technologies that the user did not imply.
